To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have found a simplified Bruggaman formula, which is applicable to the calculation of the effective refractive index of nano structured materials, and the effective third order nonlinear optical susceptibility of nano porous silicon.
the effective third order nonlinear refractive index of nano porous silicon (np Si) is 1.2 times higher than the bulk silicon value.

we have demonstrated that the third order nonlinear susceptibility of nano porous silicon is enhanced by a factor of about 1000, compared to the bulk silicon, and that this enhancement is due to a strong confinement of the electromagnetic field inside the nano porous silicon, as a consequence of the large surface to volume ratio of the nano pores.
